result.summary: The image shows a residential intersection with minimal pedestrian infrastructure, lacking marked crosswalks and curb ramps. Dense vegetation at the corner creates a significant visual obstruction, while the existing sidewalk appears partially overgrown.

hazards.name: Visual Obstruction
hazards.description: Dense vegetation at the corner blocks sightlines between approaching vehicles and pedestrians.

hazards.name: Lack of Crossing Infrastructure
hazards.description: The absence of marked crosswalks and curb ramps makes the intersection less accessible and safe for pedestrians.

interventions.title: Vegetation Management
interventions.description: Trim or remove overgrown bushes and trees at the corner to restore sightlines.

interventions.title: ADA Curb Ramps
interventions.description: Install sloped curb transitions to provide accessible paths for all users.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Paint continental or ladder-style crosswalks to clearly define pedestrian right-of-way.

result.summary: The image shows a quiet residential street with mature trees and sidewalks. While the environment feels low-speed, there is a lack of formal pedestrian crossing infrastructure and visibility is partially obstructed by parked vehicles and large tree trunks.

hazards.name: Visual Obstruction from Parked Vehicles
hazards.description: Parked cars along the curb block the sightlines between pedestrians waiting to cross and oncoming drivers.
hazards.location_in_image: Along the left and right curbs of the street.

hazards.name: Visual Obstruction from Large Trees
hazards.description: Large tree trunks positioned close to the roadway edge can obscure pedestrians from a driver's view.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side of the image, near the sidewalk edge.

interventions.title: Daylighting
interventions.description: Remove parking spaces near potential crossing points to improve visibility between pedestrians and motorists.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install marked crosswalks to clearly define pedestrian right-of-way and alert drivers to crossing locations.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install bulb-outs to shorten the crossing distance and place pedestrians in a more visible position before they enter the roadway.

result.summary: The image shows a quiet residential street with mature trees and a continuous sidewalk on the left side. There are no marked crosswalks or pedestrian signals visible, and parked cars along the curb create potential sightline obstructions for crossing pedestrians.

hazards.name: Parked Vehicle Sightline Obstruction
hazards.description: Parked cars along the curb can obscure pedestrians, particularly children, from the view of oncoming motorists.
hazards.location_in_image: Along both sides of the roadway.

interventions.title: Daylighting
interventions.description: Restricting parking near intersections or potential crossing points to improve visibility between pedestrians and drivers.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Installing marked crosswalks to clearly define pedestrian right-of-way and increase driver awareness.

result.summary: This residential intersection lacks basic pedestrian safety infrastructure such as marked crosswalks, curb ramps, and pedestrian signals. While sidewalks are present, they are narrow and sight lines are partially obstructed by a stone wall and parked vehicles.

hazards.name: Lack of marked crosswalks
hazards.description: There are no painted markings to indicate where pedestrians should cross, increasing the risk of vehicle-pedestrian conflict.

hazards.name: Missing curb ramps
hazards.description: The lack of curb ramps makes the intersection inaccessible for people with mobility aids or strollers.
hazards.location_in_image: Corner of the sidewalk near the fire hydrant

hazards.name: Visual obstructions
hazards.description: The stone wall and parked car on the right side of the image block sight lines between drivers and pedestrians.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install continental or ladder-style marked crosswalks to clearly define pedestrian right-of-way.

interventions.title: ADA-Compliant Curb Ramps
interventions.description: Install curb ramps with detectable warning surfaces at all crossing points to ensure accessibility.

interventions.title: Intersection Daylighting
interventions.description: Remove parking spaces near the corner to improve sight lines for both pedestrians and drivers.
